description:
Criteria: Owner demonstrates qualifying returning applications before and after the cutoff, strict waiting order including later enqueue of an earlier application, exclusive household/plot allocations, coordinator list/selector assignment and the gardener's own phone allocation view.
Artifact: Working application with representative synthetic fixtures and test evidence. Source: brief.md / First version must 1–3, Rules and Constraints; owner map deferral.
Prerequisites: T-008. Only T-012 waits on this checkpoint.
Excludes: map/grid evidence. Assumptions: none. Stage-1 limitation: this ordinary checkpoint ticket does not automatically enforce owner approval.
title: Checkpoint: allocation demonstration
